servicesStatus: Describe your garment and care label. Confirm which care options are currently available and suitable before arranging a service.
pricingStatus: Request a garment-specific quotation. Confirm the available service and price with the team before paying.
turnaroundStatus: Standard Garment Care & Cleaning takes approximately 3 days. Express garment care takes 2–12 hours, subject to confirmation, garment assessment and available capacity. No stain-removal or fabric-outcome guarantee is given. The actual completion date is agreed before acceptance.
arrangementsStatus: Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.
